identity.models_raw: T85V0 (retail: T85V01Y1 = "FamiLock S3" per eufy US/Best Buy; E85V0JY1 = "FamiLock S3 Max" per eufy US/B&H; user-reported pairing is the reverse)
identity.product_category: Camera-bearing smart lock (palm-vein, 2K camera, internal screen)

sdk.docs_status: Not in docs (SDK enum LOCK_85V0 label "FamiLock S3 (T85V0)")

observations.notes: ADDED (scope decision). CONFLICT: retail pages show T85V01Y1 = FamiLock S3 and E85V0JY1 = FamiLock S3 Max, but Eufy service page titles the "Familock S3 Max User Guide (T85V0)". Treat T85V0 as the family code covering both; E85V0 is an alias whose separate device_type (if any) is not evidenced. SDK type 203 assumed for both.
